title: Popularity Poll
scenario: An anonymous poll asks students to rank classmates and share the link.

answers.A: Click the link or follow the instruction quickly so you do not miss out.
answers.B: Ask the sender in the same chat to prove it is real.
answers.C: Ask a trusted adult or school staff through a known channel.
answers.D: Report/block it and do not share private details.

explanation: Popularity Poll: the trap is to make money or value leave before the story is verified. The safer move is to ask a trusted adult or school staff, not to act before verifying.
proTip: Cruel polls create harm and can collect identities.
